**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is planning a birding trip to Costa Rica.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for recommendations on the best spots to see Quetzals and tips to increase chances of spotting one.
- [PREFERENCE] User has been practicing with a portable hide and found it to be a game-changer, able to stay in it for over three hours without getting restless.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Costa Rica is a fantastic destination for birding, and spotting a Quetzal is a highlight for many birders.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Best spots to see Quetzals in Costa Rica include:
  1. Monteverde Cloud Forest Reserve
  2. Los Quetzales National Park
  3. Savegre Valley
  4. Talamanca Mountains
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for spotting Quetzals include:
  1. Hire a local guide
  2. Be patient and quiet
  3. Look for fruiting trees
  4. Visit during the right time (dry season: December to April)
  5. Early morning and late afternoon are the best times
  6. Bring binoculars and a spotting scope
  7. Stay still and quiet in the portable hide
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include being respectful of the environment, bringing layers for cool weather, and enjoying other bird species and wildlife in Costa Rica.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User found the tips helpful and plans to keep them in mind.
